outlook.statement: The Directors are optimistic about future performance of the Company.
The Directors are optimistic about future performance of the Company.

India's real GDP growth for FY 2025-26 is projected at 7.7 percent. For FY 2026-27 India's GDP growth is forecasted to range between 7.4 percent and 7.8 percent. Global economy expected to witness a synchronous rebound in 2026 with improved capital flows boosting private investment and a rebound in exports.
We believe that we are well placed to leverage on the growth opportunities in the economy.
